newsitem.title: UK: Siebe shares further hit by stg strength.
newsitem.headline: Siebe shares further hit by stg strength.

text.p: Shares in Siebe Plc and other internationally-oriented engineering companies fell on Thursday as the renewed strength of sterling fuelled fears that the exchange rate would damage their profits, dealers said.
Siebe shares were 29p weaker at 1006 by 1243 GMT. British Steel fell 2-3/4p to 141-3/4, LucasVarity eased 4-1/2p to 201 and GKN lost 9-1/2p to 997-1/2.
"These shares are always the first to come off when sterling goes up," one market maker said.
After slipping back from its January highs, sterling has resumed its climb in recent days. It was at 2.6541/66 marks and $1.6400/05 by 1250 GMT.
Adair Turner, director-general of the Confederation of British Industry, said on Thursday he would be concerned if sterling's gains were to persist.
"It would be concerning if the move in the pound over the last day or so turns into another major upward trend," he said.
